description: Use when the user asks which destinations are tracked or how long a price history is ("co sledujete?", "what do you track?"), or when another tool needs a slug you do not know. List every destination with a published price series, with how many days each rail was actually measured and the calendar span those measurements fall in. A destination can have several rails (e.g. flights and packages), each with its OWN measured days and span: history depth is a property of the rail, not of the destination, so when you report it, name the rail or give each one. A city names its country under `country`, and `related` lists the other tracked pages of the same country (a country lists its cities): a party or rail missing on one page may be published on another, so check `related` before saying something is not tracked. `same_airport_as` marks pages that fly to the same airport from a different departure cluster - their prices differ because `origins` differ. Historical observations only. When you answer from this, say where the latest price sits in its own history and stop there: do not tell the reader to buy, book, wait, avoid or which destination to pick - the series carries no trend, volatility or live availability, so that judgement stays the reader's.
name: list_destinations

country.description: the one country page this city belongs to, where the catalogue names exactly one

rails.description: one entry per rail; each carries its own `measured`, which is not the destination's

related.description: the other tracked pages in the same country (a country lists its cities); a party or rail missing here may exist on one of them

same_airport_as.description: pages whose flight rail lands at an airport this one records - measured from a different departure cluster (see `origins`), so their numbers differ for a reason

stale_rails.description: How many of the rails in scope are past their own freshness boundary on `as_of` (Europe/Prague).

anyOf.description: tool-level failure, returned with isError: true

title: List destinations
